pervert...

owow!"

When I drew a picture of it and showed it to Mama,
she got really mad and said it didn't exist, or that, if it did, she had already thrown it away.

"...Did you know?

"'Behold, a virgin shall be with child, and shall bring forth a son,

no, the questions.

...Actually, I think we were just bored because it was too hard to grasp.

"That God knows everything?"

...I only have a Mama.

was the Virgin...Maria...?

Maria, the name I was given, had been showing me the answer all along.

The second part of the Book of Matthew, chapter 1, verse 20.
"For that which is conceived in her is of the Holy Ghost".

"...You interpreted this to mean that

I had no Papa.
Mama gave birth to me thanks to the power of God."

Why did Maria have no Papa, when everyone else had a Papa and a Mama?

She had no Papa.

The sad girl, who had hated herself for being different from all of her classmates, finally found a meaning for her existence.

"So, you are...Ushiromiya Maria, I presume?"

...{f:5}Beatrice{/f}...

"Very interesting.

...There's candy.

Uu-, uu-uu-uu-uu-!!"

that candy was brought into being by magic.

"I'll do it!

I'll rinse out my mouth!

"I promise it.

"Uu-!

I'll do it!
I'll become your friend and a witch apprentice!"

"Yeah.

"......It doesn't.

Because they're all tainted.
Kihihihihi."

"All of the servants here today.

"Of course not.

The {f:5}Beatrice{/f} of 1986, the one we're so familiar with in a mysterious way, yet who has no existence...

...The minimum number of people required to create a universe is two.

A second person to nurture the world she had given birth to alone.
Because if it was born and not nurtured, it would die and disappear?

A second person to acknowledge the {f:5}Beatrice{/f} created by the first person.
